input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including inventory, records, user. The platform provides capabilities for wms, compute, compute client hystrix. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage inventory records, so that I can track and organize inventory data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage records records, so that I can track and organize records data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with wms functionality, so that I can accomplish my wms-related tasks.
